orchestkit · fix/cross-layer-frontmatter-gate

A value correct in layer A, silently gone in layer B.

Three bugs shipped in one day with that exact shape, and every gate stayed green because no gate read both sides. Step through what actually crossed the skill → command transform, and what the gate does about it now.

src/skills/<name>/SKILL.md

transform

plugins/ork/commands/<name>.md

🧬 Why an allowlist could not hold

The gate shipped in #3146 listed the three fields already known to work. Adding a fourth depended on a human editing two files. That is the guarded bug reproduced one level up — the next dropped field is simply one nobody added to the array, and the gate prints PASSED while the value is lost. Inverting it to default-deny makes an unclassified key a build failure instead of a silent pass.

📐 Where the truth actually was

Sampling 470 command files from other installed plugins found no model:, which read as evidence it was not a command field. It was not — the upstream docs say custom commands were merged into skills and both share one frontmatter schema. Absence of evidence in a sample is not evidence of absence, and that mistake was shipped once here before it was caught.


  




Counts are the real ones measured on this branch: 34 user-invocable skills, 24 distinct
frontmatter keys declared, 600 assertions per run. Single file, zero dependencies.
